verdict.rationale: AMD's Ryzen AI Software docs cover the main runtimes for this silicon. ONNX Runtime runs on the NPU via the Vitis AI EP and on the iGPU via DirectML. OGA supports NPU-only and hybrid NPU+iGPU modes, and llama.cpp provides GPU-only acceleration through the Lemonade SDK. Community owners independently report running large models with llama.cpp on the 395. Missing for 10: no MLX support (not evidenced), and the docs address Ryzen AI 300-series hardware generally rather than naming the Max+ 395 specifically.
